name: Big Boot Media Product Size Chart & Fit Finder
author: bigbootmedia

sections.description:
Big Boot Media Product Size Chart & Fit Finder adds clickable size buttons, a size chart, a size guide and a Find Your Fit recommendation modal to WooCommerce variable product pages. Store owners can configure a chest measurement size chart and fit adjustments. The customer-facing interface uses neutral branding and does not advertise Big Boot Media or The Basic Cotton.

The existing WooCommerce variation dropdown remains available to WooCommerce’s variation logic, while the size buttons provide a more visual selection interface. Designed for clothing sized using chest measurements.

Developer: Big Boot Media
Plugin homepage: https://bigbootmedia.com/wordpress-plugins/

Upgrade from The Basic Cotton Fit Assistant

On activation, if the new plugin has no saved settings, it copies the earlier plugin’s tbcfa_settings option into bbmfa_settings. Existing size charts, fit offsets and custom labels are retained. The former default heading “Find Your Basic Cotton Fit” is replaced with “Find Your Fit”, and a neutral “SIZE & FIT” eyebrow is used by default. The original settings option is not deleted.

Do not run both plugins at once. If the original plugin remains active, Size Chart & Fit Finder does not load its own front-end assets and displays an admin warning.

Default size chart

XS|36
S|38
M|40
L|42
XL|44
XXL|46

How recommendations work

The customer enters a chest measurement in inches or centimetres and chooses Fitted, Regular or Relaxed. The plugin applies the configured adjustment and suggests the nearest size. Defaults are -2 inches for Fitted, 0 for Regular and +2 for Relaxed. Recommendations are general sizing aids, not guarantees. Review the settings to match your products.

Notes

  • Front-end assets load only on variable WooCommerce product pages.
  • The native WooCommerce variation selector remains for stock and Add to Cart logic.
  • No third-party API, AI service or subscription is required.
  • No theme files are modified.
sections.installation:
1. Back up your site and preferably test on staging first.
  2. If The Basic Cotton Fit Assistant is installed, deactivate it but do not delete your saved WordPress options.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin and upload the Size Chart & Fit Finder ZIP.
  4. Activate Big Boot Media Product Size Chart & Fit Finder.
  5. Open Settings > Size Chart & Fit Finder and review the migrated settings.
  6. Confirm the size attribute slug (for example, size or pa_size), size chart, labels and fit offsets.
  7. Test the size buttons, size guide, fit recommendation and Add to Cart behaviour on a variable product page.
  8. After confirming everything works, you can remove the old plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.7

  • Renamed the public plugin to “Big Boot Media Product Size Chart & Fit Finder” to comply with WordPress.org naming requirements.
  • Removed the restricted trademark term from the plugin display name, folder, permalink and text domain.
  • Updated the intended WordPress.org slug and text domain to big-boot-media-product-size-chart-fit-finder.
  • Kept the existing internal option keys and migration logic for backwards compatibility.

1.1.4

  • Renamed the plugin to Big Boot Media Product Size Chart & Fit Finder for clearer WordPress.org discovery.
  • Updated the plugin slug, text domain, settings labels and plugin homepage path.
  • Updated WordPress.org tags to focus on size chart, size guide and size finder searches.

1.1.3

  • Added GPL licence details to the main plugin header.
  • Added WordPress compatibility metadata and reduced directory tags to five.
  • Updated product detection to avoid assigning to WooCommerce’s global product variable.

1.1.2

  • Updated the author hyperlink to the Big Boot Media homepage; the plugin site link continues to point to the WordPress plugins page.

1.1.1

  • Rebranded plugin name and author to Big Boot Media with a linked Author URI.
  • Replaced store-specific customer-facing branding with neutral editable text.
  • Added migration of existing settings from The Basic Cotton Fit Assistant.
  • Updated PHP, JavaScript and CSS identifiers to the BBM namespace.
  • Added protection against both fit assistant plugins loading at the same time.
  • Fixed duplicate modal heading IDs and removed store-specific hover colours.

1.0.1

  • Original store-specific version.
